description: Change a scheduled task: title, instructions, schedule (same shape as schedule_agent_task), max_runs, status active/paused, or deliver_results (same meaning as in schedule_agent_task). Only the fields given change. Returns the next run in UTC and in the schedule's timezone.

deliver_results.description: Whether each run's final reply is sent to the user (WhatsApp, else their verified email): true when every run's result is what they asked for; false when the agent tells them itself only when something is found, so runs stay in the task log.

name: update_agent_task
title: Update Agent Task
